# errorhandling

Structured, user-facing error reporting for Go command-line tools: exit codes
carried on the error, actionable hints, debug-gated stack traces and a
pluggable support channel.

> **This is a read-only mirror. The canonical repository is on GitLab:**
> **https://gitlab.com/phpboyscout/go/errorhandling**
>
> Issues and merge requests are handled there.

## Installing

The module path is the GitLab one, so install it with:

```
go get gitlab.com/phpboyscout/go/errorhandling
```

`go get github.com/phpboyscout/errorhandling` will not work — the mirror is
here for browsing and reference only.

## Documentation

Full documentation: https://errorhandling.go.phpboyscout.uk

Written up in [Building a command-line tool in Go](https://phpboyscout.uk/topics/building-a-cli-in-go/),
a guide covering the whole toolkit.
